classification: Native mechanism replay against immutable earlier full-model traces; not new prospective whole-model inference
objective: Verify the remaining full-attention/MLP/residual equations and analytic local responses, and distinguish conditional attention-weight free energy from whole-transformer equilibrium.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B revision2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17; exact original BF16 loader then FP32 promotion; unchanged frozen/eval parameters
sources: Ramsauer et al., Hopfield Networks is All You Need, https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.02217, attention/associative-memory connection
attribution: The entropy variational identity used here is an explicit elementary derivation for the attention probabilities. It does not assert tied-key/value Hopfield Lyapunov convergence for the gated Qwen residual block.

equations.MLP: m(x)=W_down[SiLU(W_gate*N(x))*W_up*N(x)], N is the original zero-centered RMSNorm
equations.attention: scores=q*K^T/sqrt(256), p=softmax(scores), a=p*V; output=W_out[a*sigmoid(gate)]. Include original query RMSNorm, grouped8query/2KV heads and partial rotary embeddings.
equations.conditional_attention_energy: For allowed cached tokens, F(p;s)=sum_j p_j*log(p_j)-sum_j p_j*s_j on p>=0,sum(p)=1. Its unique minimizer is softmax(s). F(p)-F(p*)=KL(p||p*) and min F=-logsumexp(s). This is conditional in current query/keys, not a potential of the whole residual state.
equations.attention_response: ds=(dq*K^T+q*dK^T)/sqrt(256), dp=(diag(p)-p*p^T)*ds; da=dp*V+p*dV, with differentiated query normalization, sigmoid gate and output projection.
equations.residual: middle=input+mixer, output=middle+MLP, with externally injected middle displacement accounted separately where present. Check first response similarly.
equations.interpretation: A changed input can change query, keys, values and gate. The attention covariance response distinguishes these from MLP gating and recurrent-memory resistance; no arbitrary energy residual detector is implied.

panel.primal: All92 phase18 native panel cases (12 normal and80 actual), all24 MLPs and6 full-attention layers, complete1024 output coordinates.
panel.response: Same16 question/direction/position cases as phase18: primary6 questions and reference2 questions, both positions; compare all24 MLP and6 attention derivatives to stored native q.
panel.calibration_gate: Before wider panel, both normal token positions and primary derivatives on original phase17 calibration question r17_cal_spoon must pass. A failure stops broader scientific panel, preserves all failed data and exports failure.
panel.prefix: Use hash-verified immutable incoming prefix KV; append current native KV and, on token2, recorded previous1 KV. Prefix derivative is zero; previous1/current derivatives are taken from stored native q.

gates_frozen_before_native_replay.residual_full_field: error<=1e-5*max(1,||target||); record explicit middle-intervention displacement rather than applying an unmodified skip identity there
gates_frozen_before_native_replay.failure_policy: Keep every failure; no held-driven threshold changes or omitted heads. Record source, parameter and parent checksums.

preservation: Preserve full replay/derivative outputs and full attention score/probability/derivative vectors, exact source/parameter digests and private parent references. Original weights remain pinned publicly cached; do not duplicate the full checkpoint. Keep all earlier scientific failures unchanged. Release model promptly after obtaining used public parameter arrays. Stop owned workers/services and close unused tabs.
